output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Build 7.4.0 crashes at about 2% from 2 Sep, before the flag ramp started, against about 0.7% for 7.3.2. Only 7.4.0 users can get the flag, so the flag comparison is really a 7.4.0 versus 7.3.2 comparison. The largest crash cluster, 41% of events, is a native crash in the upgraded image library (Pixelda), which 7.3.2 doesn't have. Within 7.4.0, flag-on users crash at 2.10% against 1.98% for the random holdout. That gap is small and not statistically distinguishable from zero. Device memory and usage mix are the same across groups, and the sync-service deploy did not move the 7.3.2 rate. The crash-reporting SDK upgrade doesn't explain it, because the app store's own OS-level console shows the same gap. A small flag effect, a few tenths of a point, can't be ruled out yet. I'm fairly confident in this. Don't turn the flag off and push 7.4.0 to 100%, because that would ship the real problem to everyone. Hold the rollout at 25% and fix the Pixelda decode crash. Keep the flag holdout running, and widen it if you want an answer sooner.
